### 📓 Docs Drift Check
Nothing in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **0** changed package(s)), so **this run has no opinion** about the docs.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **0** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 9c5fb3efdf33a8e343442739e0ebeef1b1e47251` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `261221ef1b88fd8202700c1113d3fde5196ba376`
Local-runs: probe — byte count of the hand-written string literals in `packages/spec/scripts/lib/platform-catalog.ts` at base and head, by a text tokenizer over `git show` output (no project code imported, nothing built, tested or re-run): no check-run reports the figure the ceiling claims to be pinned at
Scope: skills/objectstack-project/evals/project-process.json, skills/objectstack-project/references/platform-catalog.md + packages/spec/scripts/lib/platform-catalog.ts, packages/spec/scripts/platform-catalog.test.ts
Security-touching: yes
Rule-change-verified: `none`

PR #37132 (card #37058), net diff against `main` (`f588898ca0`; merge-base `63ab4794eb`, and `main` has not moved on any path read here). The verdict is FAIL on one must-fix: the navigation entry the rows and the eval teach is refused by `defineStack`.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Spec accept-set: unchanged. Right.** No `packages/spec/src/**`, no schema, no runtime code. The diff is generator data under the unpublished `packages/spec/scripts/`, its ceiling pin, the regenerated page and one eval case.
- **Catalog rows admitted. Right.** `sys_task` and `sys_note` are in `PLATFORM_OBJECTS_BY_PACKAGE['platform-objects']`, so `catalogProblems` admits both rows. The two page rows carry the generator strings unchanged.
- **"Mounted by: every boot". Right.** No capability token has `@objectstack/platform-objects` as its provider, so `mountedBy` derives it. `serve` registers `PlatformObjectsPlugin` on every kernel that lacks it, and the plugin registers `WORK_OBJECTS_MANIFEST` (both objects and the assignee sharing rule) in `init`.
- **Published surface: `@objectstack/skills` only.** The page gains one group of two rows and one reworded cell; the eval file gains case 10. The derivation is right; the content is wrong in one place (M1) and loses teaching in another (S1).
- **One gate loosens.** `HAND_WRITTEN_CEILING_TOKENS` 1581 → 1708: the test accepts 127 more tokens of hand-written text. The number is the measurement; its precondition is judged in ③.
- **Card against code.** The card gives one view list for both objects. `sys_task` ships `assigned_to_me`, `created_by_me`, `all`; `sys_note` ships `mine`, `all`. The dev's correction is right and the card is wrong about the note.

### ② Semver level

`'@objectstack/skills': patch`, with `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` on the PR body and the changeset. This matches what the diff publishes: additive teaching text in the skills bundle, and nothing from `@objectstack/spec`, whose `files` ships no `scripts/` path. `Clause-②: no` is right, since no declared capability is narrowed. `Check Changeset` concluded success. The changeset's sentence "The `sys_comment` row no longer reads as the notes table" follows S1 and moves with its fix.

### ③ Boundary flags

1. **Ceiling raise 1581 → 1708 (the dev's open question).**
   - **Is 1708 the measurement? Yes.** Base hand-written text is 6320 bytes (1580 tokens); head is 6831 bytes, and ceil(6831 / 4) = 1708, pinned with 0 headroom. The delta is the PR body's: 9 bytes cut, 520 added (15 group title, 22 + 309 for the task row, 14 + 160 for the note row).
   - **Quote and arithmetic: present.** The PR body and the test comment quote 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 with ruling record 6513306068, and the body carries the arithmetic.
   - **Is the cut-first condition honestly met? Not on this head.** The only deletion shown is the 9 bytes of " or notes", and that is a teaching change, not a restatement (S1).
   - **Is there more restatement that should have gone first? Very little.** The base text has no block of it. Two small real ones exist, each keeping another home: `sys_mail_message`'s "rows arrive only from the host's IMAP sync" beside the `sys_mailbox` row it points at, and `sys_work_calendar_exception`'s "kept in Setup" under `sys_work_calendar`'s "kept per organization in Setup". The new text also writes "no link to another record" twice. Those are the cuts the path asks for, and they roughly pay for the key M1 adds.
   - **The remainder, about 500 bytes, is the card's ordered facts.** Deletion cannot pay for it without cutting other rows' teaching, so a raise by measurement is the right instrument, re-measured on the fixed head.
   - **Whose raise is it?** The ratchet header and the test's own comment give this path to a PR "with no per-card ruling", checked by this record, so option A is open on the gate's terms. `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` tells a dev who cannot delete an equal amount to report `blocked` and not raise a ceiling itself. That half is the seat's: escalated to the seat, recommendation A. The dev disclosed the deviation and the hunk is separable.
2. **Views.** Judged from `sys-task.object.ts` and `sys-note.object.ts`: the rows and the eval are right (① last bullet).
3. **Dropped `description`; "no delete" not spelled.** No false claim in either row. Both omissions are graded nit (N1, N2).
4. **Reach and "every boot".** "Every boot" holds (①). The reach as spelled does not build: M1.
5. **`sys_comment` cell.** S1.
6. **SQL push-down.** The diff has no query, no id materialisation and no in-app join. Nothing to find.
7. **Security teaching, and why the line reads `yes`.** The changed hunks teach who reads a task and a note (the private sharing model and the effect of the `sys_task_assignee` rule), what `member_default` grants, and, in eval 10, that "no permission set or sharing rule is written". All of it is true in the code:
   - both objects are `sharingModel: 'private'` over `owner_id`;
   - the rule is a `field` recipient on `assignee_id`;
   - `member_default` carries read, create and edit for both objects, with `allowDelete: false` and no row policy;
   - `member_default` is the additive baseline every member holds, even beside an app's own default set (`composeHumanBaselinePermissionSets`);
   - `sharing` is an always-on capability.

   True or not, it is permission and sharing behaviour, so this PR is not for the low-risk skills arm; the seat adds the `security` label.
8. **Check-runs on the head, read 2026-11-24 about 22:00Z.** 65 runs: 21 success, 11 skipped, 33 in progress, 0 failed.
   - Success includes `Check Changeset`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates` and `Type Check · source gates`.
   - Still in progress: `Test Core` 1 to 10 (which carries the generator test), `Build Core`, three `Type Check` lanes, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` and the UI lanes.
   - No gate has answered red. The verdict below does not wait on the open ones.

### ④ Design judgment

**M1 (must-fix) — the taught navigation entry is refused by `defineStack`.**

- **What is taught.** The task row's reach opens "a `type: 'object'` navigation entry names it", and the note row inherits it ("as `sys_task`"). Eval 10's expected output says "Adds a `type: 'object'` navigation entry whose `objectName` is `sys_task` ... and declares nothing else".
- **What the spec does on `main`.** `validateCrossReferences` in `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` (the app-navigation block) refuses a `type: 'object'` entry whose `objectName` is not among the stack's own `objects`, unless the entry carries `requiresObject`. The message is `App 'NAME' navigation references object 'sys_task' which is not defined in objects.` `collectObjectNames` reads the stack's own objects only, never the platform registry. The pass runs in the default strict mode for any stack that declares at least one object.
- **Where it is pinned.**
  - `packages/spec/src/stack-artifact-crossref.test.ts`, "does NOT widen an app's own navigation", pins the refusal.
  - `packages/lint/src/validate-object-references.test.ts`, "accepts gated navigation entries naming the built-in sys_task and sys_note", pins the working spelling `{ type: 'object', objectName: 'sys_task', requiresObject: 'sys_task' }`. It came with the PR that shipped the objects, and its comment says "`defineStack` refuses a `type: 'object'` entry naming an object the stack does not declare unless it does".
  - `lint-view-refs.ts` honours the same key for `viewName`.
- **Why the reader cannot recover.** Nothing under `skills/objectstack-project/**` names `requiresObject`. The one file in the bundle that does, `objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md`, presents it as a hide-when-missing gate for an optional object, which an "every boot" row tells the reader they do not need.
- **What happens.** An agent that follows the row and the eval's "declares nothing else" gets a refusal saying the object "is not defined in objects". That pushes it toward declaring its own task object, which is what the card exists to stop.
- **Fix.** The task row's reach spells the entry with `requiresObject` naming the object, and the note row follows through "as `sys_task`". Eval 10's expected output spells `requiresObject: 'sys_task'` and `must_contain` asserts it.

**S1 (should-fix) — the `sys_comment` cell is not a restatement cut.**

"a comments or notes table" → "a comments table" is justified in the PR as a second home for notes now that `sys_note` has a row. The new row says of itself "no link to another record", so it is not the home for notes kept on a record. That case is what the `sys_comment` row, a thread on every object, was catching. After the change, an app that needs notes on a customer finds "notes" only on a row that says it cannot attach to one. The card asks for two rows, not for this edit. Restore the cell, or word it so record notes still land there ("a comments or record-notes table"). The cut-first deletion then comes from real restatement (③ item 1).

**Nits.** Free to fold in, since the head moves for M1.

- N1 (nit) — the task row's field list reads complete and omits `description` (rich text, in the object and its docblock). The card's own list omits it too.
- N2 (nit) — "grants read, create and edit" is a closed list and true. That a member cannot delete a task (`allowDelete: false`, while the object's own API serves delete) is left to inference on a row that ends "data API". The dev's reason for avoiding "no delete" is sound, because this page uses it for an object's API; "not delete" inside the grant clause avoids the collision.
- N3 (nit) — "creator and assignee read a task" understates the assignee, whose share is `edit`.
- N4 (nit) — eval 10's `must_not_contain` (`name: 'todo'`, `name: 'task'`) misses the spelling the namespace rule forces on a real app (`name: 'crm_todo'`). The positive assertions carry the case today.

**Per file.**

- `skills/objectstack-project/references/platform-catalog.md` — generated, and equal to its source. The fields, the platform-written `completed_at` (`work/hooks.ts`), "no link to another record", both view lists, the privacy and grant clauses, "data API" (neither object restricts `enable.apiMethods`) and "every boot" hold against the code. It fails on M1 and loses teaching on S1.
- `skills/objectstack-project/evals/project-process.json` — case 10 answers the card's ask, and its facts hold, as does its "no permission set or sharing rule is written". Its taught entry is M1.
- `packages/spec/scripts/lib/platform-catalog.ts` — the source of both of the above, with the same findings. The group and rows sit in the right structure, and the guard admits them.
- `packages/spec/scripts/platform-catalog.test.ts` — the ledger comment's arithmetic is right and the pin is at the measurement. Its clause "`sys_comment` no longer reads as the notes table, which the new row is" falls with S1. The number is re-measured on the fixed head.

M1 and S1 each earn a delta review of their fix. This record covers `261221ef1b` only.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-37058-catalog-sys-task-note`
Reviewed-by: `session_01QSeKYo86w1wqy2z2fMrryr`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYo86w1wqy2z2fMrryr

Adopting contract review 7145761197: `Security-touching: yes` (the new rows and eval 10 teach row privacy, the assignee sharing rule's effect and `member_default`'s grant). Adding `security`; this PR is Tier H and goes to the seat once the fix round passes its delta review. The teaching is public skills prose about shipped behaviour, not a vulnerability.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `1239e77fd649ba695a64a4217bfc9f7cefae3f04`
Local-runs: probe — byte count of the hand-written string literals in `packages/spec/scripts/lib/platform-catalog.ts` at base and this head, by a text tokenizer over `git show` output (no project code imported, nothing built, tested or re-run): no check-run reports the figure the ceiling claims to be pinned at
Scope: skills/objectstack-project/evals/project-process.json, skills/objectstack-project/references/platform-catalog.md + packages/spec/scripts/lib/platform-catalog.ts, packages/spec/scripts/platform-catalog.test.ts
Security-touching: yes
Rule-change-verified: `none`

DELTA review from `261221ef1b88fd8202700c1113d3fde5196ba376` (record 7145761197: must-fix M1, should-fix S1, nits N1 to N4) to this head. One fix commit sits between the two heads. This record judges what that commit changed and the gates on this head; everything else stands as the earlier record read it. `main` has not moved on any path read here.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Spec accept-set: still unchanged. Right.** The fix commit touches the same five files and nothing under `packages/spec/src/**`.
- **The page equals its source. Right.** The five changed page rows carry the generator strings unchanged.
- **The ceiling pin moves again, 1708 → 1719.** Against `main` the test now accepts 138 more tokens of hand-written text (1581 → 1719). The number is the measurement (③ item 1).
- **Eval 10 tightens.** `must_contain` gains `requiresObject`. The expected output contains all three positive strings and neither negative one.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. The changeset's text was rewritten to match the rows (the `requiresObject` entry, "not delete", "a comments or record-notes table") and reads true against the tree. `Check Changeset` concluded success on the push run for this head.

### ③ Boundary flags

1. **Ceiling raise, re-judged.**
   - **Is 1719 the measurement? Yes.** Base hand-written text is 6320 bytes; this head is 6875 bytes, and ceil(6875 / 4) = 1719. The pin has 1 byte of slack inside its last token.
   - **Arithmetic: right.** 6320 less 47 cut plus 602 added is 6875. The 602 is 7 on the `sys_comment` cell, 15 for the group title, 22 + 392 for the task row and 14 + 152 for the note row. The test's ledger comment states the same figures.
   - **Is the cut-first condition honestly met? Yes, on this head.** 47 bytes of base text are deleted from the same file, and each keeps another home:
     - `sys_mail_message` (32 bytes): "rows arrive only from the host's IMAP sync (the `sys_mailbox` row)" becomes "rows as the `sys_mailbox` row says". The `sys_mailbox` row still says rows exist only where the host composes the mailbox service with an IMAP account source.
     - `sys_work_calendar_exception` (15 bytes): ", kept in Setup" goes. The `sys_work_calendar` row above it still says "kept per organization in Setup", and the exception row still calls itself "a calendar's" holidays.
   - **Does a cut lose teaching? No.** Both facts are still on the page, one row away, and the shortened rows point at them. "No link to another record" is now said once, in the task row, for both objects; that is new text tightened, not a base cut.
   - **The dev's report splits the 47 as 33 and 14.** The tree measures 32 and 15. The total and the pin are the same, so nothing in the tree depends on it.
   - **Quote.** The test comment quotes 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」. The PR body's arithmetic and head are stale and the seat refreshes them; not graded here.
   - **Whose raise it is** stays where the earlier record left it, with the seat. Nothing in the tree turns on it.
2. **`requiresObject` as now spelled.** Task row: "a `type: 'object'` navigation entry with `objectName` and `requiresObject` both `sys_task`". That is the spelling `packages/lint/src/validate-object-references.test.ts` pins, and the one `validateCrossReferences` in `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` admits. Eval 10 spells `objectName: 'sys_task'` and `requiresObject: 'sys_task'`, and its stated reason is what the code does.
3. **Note row.** "as `sys_task`, naming `sys_note`" reads one way: the same entry with both keys naming `sys_note`. That is the second entry the lint test pins.
4. **N2 and N3 wording against the code.**
   - "`member_default` grants read, create and edit, not delete" matches the two lines in `default-permission-sets.ts` (`allowDelete: false`).
   - "creator and assignee open a task" is true and no longer limits the assignee to reading; the `sys_task_assignee` rule's `edit` share is still not spelled.
5. **SQL push-down.** The fix commit has no query, no id materialisation and no in-app join. Nothing to find.
6. **Security teaching.** Unchanged in kind: the rows and eval 10 still teach row privacy, the effect of the assignee sharing rule and the `member_default` grant, now with "not delete". All of it is true in the code, and it is still permission and sharing behaviour, so the line stays `yes` and the PR is not for the low-risk skills arm.
7. **Check-runs on this head, read 2026-11-24 about 22:13Z.** 50 runs: 17 success, 12 skipped, 21 in progress, none red.
   - Success includes `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · ESLint`, `Type Check · source gates`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards` (both runs), `Spec property liveness` and `Check Changeset` (the push run).
   - Still in progress: `Test Core` 1 to 10 (which carries the generator test), `Build Core`, `Build UI Deps`, `Live E2E UI`, three `Type Check` lanes, four `Lint` lanes and a second `Check Changeset` run started by a later PR event at 22:12Z.
   - The generator test's own gate had not answered when this was written. By the byte count above it holds: 6875 bytes is within 1719 tokens. Landing waits on the open runs.

### ④ Design judgment

- **M1: closed.** The task row, the note row and eval 10 now teach the entry `defineStack` admits, and eval 10 asserts `requiresObject` (③ items 2 and 3).
- **S1: closed.** The `sys_comment` cell reads "a comments or record-notes table", so notes kept on a record land on the thread again. The cut-first deletion now comes from real restatement (③ item 1).

No must-fix, no should-fix.

**Nits.** None moves the head.

- N1 (nit) — still open, accepted: the task row's field list omits `description`. The dev declined it as not free under the ceiling.
- N2 (nit) — folded in: "not delete" is in the grant clause.
- N3 (nit) — folded in as far as a nit needs: "open" replaces "read".
- N4 (nit) — still open, accepted: eval 10's `must_not_contain` keeps the unprefixed names, as the file's other cases do.
- N5 (nit) — new: "rows as the `sys_mailbox` row says" is terse to the point of needing a second read. The pointer is right and the fact is one row up.

**Per file, the fix commit only.**

- `skills/objectstack-project/references/platform-catalog.md` — regenerated and equal to its source. The five changed rows hold against the code.
- `skills/objectstack-project/evals/project-process.json` — case 10's entry, its reason and its new assertion hold.
- `packages/spec/scripts/lib/platform-catalog.ts` — the same five row edits; nothing else moved.
- `packages/spec/scripts/platform-catalog.test.ts` — the ledger comment's figures and its two named cuts are what the tree measures, and the pin is at the measurement.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · L1 · head `1239e77fd649ba695a64a4217bfc9f7cefae3f04` · 2026-11-24T22:40Z

1. **Shape.** 5 files: generator data `packages/spec/scripts/lib/platform-catalog.ts` (a "Tasks and notes" group with `sys_task` and `sys_note` rows; `sys_comment` cell "a comments or record-notes table"; two same-file restatement cuts), the regenerated `skills/objectstack-project/references/platform-catalog.md` (equal to its source), eval case 10 in `skills/objectstack-project/evals/project-process.json`, the generator test's hand-written ceiling 1581 → 1719, one `@objectstack/skills` patch changeset.

Facts read from the code: the task's views are `assigned_to_me`, `created_by_me`, `all`; the note's are `mine`, `all` (the card's list was the task's); `member_default` grants read, create and edit, `allowDelete: false`; the nav entry needs `requiresObject` (`stack.zod.ts` app-navigation cross-ref).

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:做应用的 AI 助手在「平台已自带什么」目录里能查到内置的任务和备忘两个对象,需要待办或备忘时直接用平台的,不再自己另建一套。
- 为什么做:平台新带了任务和备忘,目录没跟上,属于起步应用这条线上技能说明的补漏。
- 出错会怎样:写错的话助手会被引到不存在的视图或权限说法上;只动说明文字和一条测评,撤回这一个合并即可。
- 要你做什么:批准合并。只改技能说明文字、一条测评和生成器测试的文本上限;因为教到行级可见性和 `member_default` 授权,契约审核判它「涉及权限」,按需人工批准处理。另有一处小事随批准认可:生成器测试的手写文本上限 1581→1719,先删 47 字节真重复,余额按实测提高(依裁决 6513306068 的 A 路线)。契约审核 PASS:记录 7145995541,Head-sha `1239e77fd649ba695a64a4217bfc9f7cefae3f04`。

Hand-off · 2026-11-24T22:42Z · @os-zhuang — PR #37132 (card #37058) is ready for your approval. Skills text, one eval case and the generator test's text ceiling; Tier H because the contract review reads `Security-touching: yes` (it teaches row visibility and the `member_default` grant). Zone L1 ACCEPT 7146524840 at this head; contract review PASS 7145995541 (delta over the FAIL 7145761197, M1/S1 closed), Head-sha `1239e77fd649ba695a64a4217bfc9f7cefae3f04`; 0 failed check-runs. The ceiling raise follows ruling 6513306068 route A (trim 47 bytes of true duplication first, raise the rest by measurement), which the seat confirms. After your approval the seat lands it.
